audience: teams that email bulletins to subscribers through GovDelivery topics

useCases.title: Check a subscriber's topic subscriptions
useCases.text: Look up a subscriber by email address to read their topic subscriptions and record fields. List the topics to get their codes.

useCases.title: Add opted-in subscribers to topics
useCases.text: Add one subscriber to topics, or replace their topic list with the codes you give. Use it only for people who opted in.

useCases.title: Draft and send a bulletin
useCases.text: Create a draft bulletin for chosen topics. Send it only after you approve the exact draft, because sending cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Check whether a bulletin was sent
useCases.text: Read one bulletin by id to see its subject, its state (draft or sent), its topics and its total subscribers.
